title: Merge cleanup refuses to remove a worktree a live session holds
action: Widen live_session_holds to pub(crate) in packages/bee-rs/crates/bee/src/verbs/worktree/prune.rs. In packages/bee-rs/crates/bee/src/verbs/worktree/merge.rs perform_cleanup, after the dirty check and before teardown_worktree, call live_session_holds with the session-heartbeat window HEARTBEAT_STALE_SECONDS (900s, claims.rs:36) — NOT prune's 6h constant — and on Some(reason) return ok:false with new code WORKTREE_MERGE_CLEANUP_LIVE_SESSION and a reason naming the holding session plus the remedy (close that session, rerun bee worktree merge --id <id>, or let bee worktree prune sweep later). Merge itself still lands; only directory removal is refused. Add tests in packages/bee-rs/crates/bee/src/verbs/worktree/tests.rs: (1) fresh-heartbeat session record naming the worktree's workspace id makes perform_cleanup return the new code and leaves the directory in place; (2) a stale-heartbeat record does not block removal.
intent: bee worktree merge's cleanup deletes the floor under a live session (git worktree remove --force, no liveness check), stranding that session behind WORKTREE_LINK_INVALID denials. Reuse prune's live_session_holds so removal waits for the session to go stale.
